nom: Kopari Beauty Sun Shield On-The-Glow Sheer Stick Sunscreen SPF 40

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the stick as slippery and greasy on the face, with one reporting a breakout after one use and another choosing to reserve it for the body instead.
segments.dry: One reviewer with severe dry skin reports the product feels oily on top yet leaves skin feeling more dry once it sets, while another with dry, sun-damaged skin praises it for not leaving a white mask or drying her face.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: one reports no breakouts or burning and works well on darker skin, while another describes a sensitive rash with burning on the neck, cheeks and forehead the day after use, and a third reports slight irritation on the face.
segments.mature: A reviewer identifying as more mature reports the product works well for her where other sunscreens have not, giving glow without issue.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who mentions being on the mature end of the age spectrum reports the product works for her skin when other products have not.
concerns.dehydration: A reviewer with severe dry skin reports the product leaves her feeling more dry after it dries down despite an oily after-feel; another dry-skin reviewer instead reports it avoids the drying, white-mask effect she gets from other sunscreens.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a rash with burning on the neck, cheeks and forehead the day after use, and another with sensitive skin reports slight facial irritation; other sensitive-skin reviewers report no burning or reaction at all.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically describe barrier-related effects such as stinging on compromised skin beyond the isolated burning/rash reports.
concerns.spots: No reviewers specifically discuss dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts report none, including on skin that breaks out easily; one reviewer with oily skin reports it broke her out after a single use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers highlight the finish as non-greasy and not oily on the skin, while multiple others, especially those with oily skin, describe it as greasy, slippery, or leaving skin feeling oily, particularly on the face.

aspects.libelle: Greasy or oily finish on face
Sticky feel, hard to wash off

extraits.titre: Not for my oily skinned girls
extraits.texte: I wanted to like this product, waited so long to try it. I have oily skin, when i put this on it made my skin look nice but to the touch slippery and oily to anything it touches like your hair or fingers. It broke me out within one use. Had a nice smell though.

The smell of this sunscreen is nice, but it is super greasy. I had to reapply several times in a six hour day outside. My face still got sunburned on my cheeks and nose. I also woke up the following day with a rash on my neck, cheeks, and forehead. It was quite sensitive, and it burned. I'm not a fan of this product.

I love the compactness of this product. It is really easy to apply and I can just toss it in my purse. I did try this over make up as well and it did transfer slightly but nothing some setting powder can't fix. I will say I wish it were more hydrating and less oily. I have severe dry skin and I feel like once this dries down I feel more dry but really oily. I would however purchase this again considering the easy application.

I am pale, it is what it is. In my youth I would try to tan but it would end with me burnt in under 15 minutes of direct sun. I've come to terms with how fair I am and now I protect my skin as much as possible, BUT, most sunblocks don't work on my skin (of course SIGH). This little stick of gold does though! It isn't heavy or greasy and I can use it on my face, neck, ears, and body with no breakouts or irritation. The glitter isn't overwhelming either. It lasted through several hours of hot, sweaty days during Fourth of July and a trip to a Midwest theme park, leaving me as paperwhite as ever. I even used it on my sunburn prone niece and nephew during a July outdoor celebration and neither of them burned either. Konpari Beauty now has a life long fan in this porcelain skinned woman!

Love the no mess stick! The size is perfect to carry anywhere. The aroma is beachy, just love this moisturizing sunscreen. Sadly my years of sun have caught up with me, so I am always on the hunt for a good sunscreen that does not leave a white mask or is drying to my face. The glitter is fun too, not too much.
I have very sensitive skin, this product works very well, product didn't cause my face to break out or burn when applied.

I used this for the first time while at a full on sun party! The sparkle was perfect and the SPF did its thing! The glowy look was fantastic! I appreciate this product as I am more on the mature side of the age spectrum and not everything works like this! Thank you Kopari for making this magical product!!
